title: AI helps resolve an unknown regulatory mechanism in bacterial acetyl-CoA synthetase
summary: Researchers at the University of Greifswald resolved how a post-translational modification regulates Bacillus subtilis acetyl-CoA synthetase, a central metabolic enzyme. The study used AI-based structural prediction to explain the molecular mechanism at near-atomic detail.

evidence.tested: Researchers at the University of Greifswald resolved how a post-translational modification regulates Bacillus subtilis acetyl-CoA synthetase, a central metabolic enzyme.
evidence.unknown: The institutional announcement says the regulatory mechanism is evolutionarily conserved and may matter in higher organisms; that implication is not itself a demonstration in those organisms.
evidence.ai_role: AlphaFold2 structural predictions supported the researchers' mechanistic interpretation of how the enzyme is regulated; the source describes a collaboration with biochemical and structural experiments, not an AI-only result.
